Code Review ✅ Approved 🟡 Medium risk · MagicStudio now accepts only HTTP 200 JPEG/JPG responses, so legitimate non-200 responses or other image formats could fail image generation. Adds HTTP 200 and JPEG/JPG content-type validation to MagicStudio image generation so unsuccessful responses report the status or content type and body instead of printing an empty `Saved image as` message and exiting 0. Response handling is extracted into a private helper with tests covering error and success cases. No issues found.
